source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: A couple that must withdraw because of injury or illness after a final round has commenced is awarded last place for each dance in which it did not dance.

format: NDCA Sanctioned events, final round withdrawal
requirement: For a future verified NDCA profile only: record a documented injury/illness withdrawal after the Final starts and award last place for each dance not performed, never across all dances or the overall competition. Studio/Custom behavior (X-5) is unchanged.
decision_refs: OD-08 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A; retrospective audit PR #795)
interpretation_notes: Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed. The rule does not define commences, several withdrawals, mid-dance exits or how last place enters Skating totals; the Skating System algorithm is NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE (OD-24 blocker). The July 2026 edition (candidate, unreviewed) has identical wording.
